name: 4U
source: The protagonist is a homonculus created by Count Demagogue, a man who loves to lie. He was created to deceive as many people as possible, just like the Count, who has mastered every trick in the book of fraud. However, he was born without the special abilities he should have, which enraged Count Demagogue. The Count commands him to deceive enough people in one day to make Demagogue acknowledge him. But he has set the condition that if he doesn't, he will be disposed of...
translation: 主角是煽动伯爵创造的同人，是一个爱说谎的人。他被创造出来是为了欺骗尽可能多的人，就像伯爵一样，他掌握了欺诈书中的所有技巧。然而他生来就没有应有的特殊能力，这激怒了煽动伯爵。伯爵命令他在一天内欺骗足够多的人，以使煽动者承认他。但他却提出了一个条件，如果他不这样做，他就会被处理掉……
